name: Orebro County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the chief with crossed arrows and the flames

description: A banner of the county arms: a white field with a blue eagle and flames, beneath a red chief bearing crossed golden arrows.
history: The flag is the heraldic banner of the arms of Orebro County, derived from the coat of arms of the historic province of Narke.

features.role: banner of the arms of Orebro County
